result.description: Open-source Postgres development platform: managed database, auth, storage, edge functions, realtime, and a Management API for projects.
result.auth_detail: Management API: OAuth2 auth-code (apps act for users; token endpoint api.supabase.com/v1/oauth/token, refresh tokens) or Personal Access Token (full-privilege, plus scoped PATs in alpha), both sent as Bearer. Per-project data APIs (PostgREST/Auth/Storage) use project API keys (anon/publishable, service_role/secret) and user JWTs.
result.access_detail: Free signup gives PATs and the ability to register OAuth apps (organization settings) with no review gate. Free plan projects have usable APIs; limits/pausing on free tier, higher quotas on paid plans. Plan pricing page not fetched directly.
result.api_notes: Management API (api.supabase.com/v1, REST/OpenAPI) covers projects, orgs, branches, secrets, edge functions, SQL query, auth config, etc. Each project also exposes auto-generated REST (PostgREST), optional GraphQL (pg_graphql), Realtime websockets, Storage and Auth APIs. Official SDKs in many languages and a CLI.

evidence.quote: PATs are tokens with a custom expiry that you manually generate to access the Management API.
OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user, providing secure and limited access to their account without requiring their credentials.
All API requests require an access token to be included in the Authorization header
The Supabase MCP server is hosted at https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp and supports the Streamable HTTP transport with OAuth authentication.
